carbon_policy_signal.item: EU Parliament relaxes nature/environmental permitting rules under right-wing pressure, accelerates industrial infrastructure (gas plants, peakers); Spain climate-skeptic pivot post-Nov 29 election threatens renewable deployment capex.
carbon_policy_signal.why_it_matters: Faster gas plant permitting raises thermal supply flexibility and lowers curtailment risk; Spain climate reversal could increase thermal intensity and raise EUA floor if coal displacement weakens. Net effect on EUA: policy conflict (permitting bullish, Spain renewal slowdown bearish); watch Iberian power spreads and thermal merit order signaling.

freshness_caveat: Coal (336 days old, as of 2025-12-26) and Clean Dark (331 days old, as of 2025-12-31) are stale; analysis relies on live Clean Spark (94th pctile), DE Power (90th pctile, -19.3% daily), GB Power (90th pctile, -22.8% daily), and Storage (67.2%, 18.2pp below seasonal, as of 2026-11-25). TTF, renewables, and EUA current as of 2026-11-25 or 2026-11-27.
risk_flags: Storage at 67.2% (18.2pp below seasonal) with renewable share at 24th percentile; thermal dispatch will dominate winter merit order and lock in high power prices.
Spain PP-Vox coalition post-Nov 29 could slow Iberian wind/solar; Iberian baseload spreads may steepen and EUA floor risk if thermal intensity rises.
Ukraine energy ceasefire language in peace talks could strip 5–15pp war premium from TTF if materialized; monitor negotiation signaling closely.
US gas storage 2% above 5yr avg reduces LNG export urgency; keeps TTF-HH arbitrage narrow and LNG import secondary heading into Northern Hemisphere draw season.

base.summary: Gas in-the-money, thermal dispatch sustained; storage refill steady; Spain election outcome priced into Iberian baseload; no major geopolitical relief.

downside.summary: Spain PP-Vox climate reversal confirmed; renewable capex delayed; EU green financing persists; mild winter accelerates storage build; thermal dispatch unwinds, gas loses merit order.

upside.summary: Ukraine energy ceasefire announced; war premium strips 10–15pp from TTF; LNG imports ease; cold front delays storage drawdown, tightens power; DE power rallies.

themes: Gas firmly in-the-money; storage deficit intensifies refill urgency
Spain climate policy reversal risk pressures EU renewable capex
Ukraine energy ceasefire as war-premium release valve for TTF
Green financing shortfall delays grid modernization; storage arbitrage windows narrow
top_drivers: Clean Spark at 94th percentile locks gas-in-the-money despite coal at 8th pctile; thermal dispatch regime sustained by storage deficit (67.2%, 18.2pp below seasonal) and renewables at 24th pctile.

Spain election (Nov 29) climate-skeptic swing and EU permitting relaxation create structural headwind for renewable deployment and capex financing; Iberian spreads and EUA tail risk on thermal intensity.
Ukraine energy ceasefire as pivotal geopolitical relief: any formalized Russian gas truce would strip 5–15pp war premium from TTF and compress LNG import premium vs HH arbitrage.
top_takeaway: Clean Spark at 94th percentile signals sustained gas-in-the-money; storage 18.2pp below seasonal norm pressures winter refill; Spain election (Nov 29) threatens EU renewable deployment via climate-skeptic pivot.

watchlist.metric: Clean Spark ratio vs coal displacement
watchlist.why: At 94th percentile (48.75 EUR/MWh), gas remains strongly in-the-money vs coal (8th pctile, 96 USD/t); fuel switch regime intact but downstream to renewable shares (24th pctile) and storage deficit.
67.2% fill, 18.2pp below seasonal, pressures H2 2026 and H1 2027 power curve; every 1pp weekly drawdown extends refill deadline and raises winter tail-risk premium.
PP-Vox coalition could slow Spain renewable deployment (largest EU wind/solar capacity); material for Iberian power baseload and EUA floor if thermal dispatch increases.
Any formalized Russia–Ukraine gas ceasefire removes 5–15pp war-risk premium from TTF and reduces LNG displacement flows; watch negotiation outcomes for volatility inflection.

watchlist.metric: EU green bond issuance shortfall (€100bn within one month)
watchlist.why: Delays renewable capex velocity; slower grid modernization and storage build compress peak/off-peak spreads and narrow Cal+1 power optionality.

watchlist_dated.name: Spain election; PP-Vox coalition formation
watchlist_dated.why: Climate policy pivot risk directly threatens EU renewable capex velocity and Iberian power baseload.

watchlist_dated.name: EU green bond issuance deadline
watchlist_dated.why: €100bn shortfall impact on renewable capex deployment and storage build-out timeline materializes; near-term power and storage arb window compression.
